verdict.rationale: NY DTF's own Online Services account lets a business see its filing and payment history and view bills and notices. That is a real status view for filings, but it sits behind an authenticated account, not on public pages. The only public lookup in the evidence is the STAR credit delivery schedule, which shows area-wide issue dates rather than the status of a specific filing, application, or case. Missing for 10: status lookup from public (unauthenticated) pages, any application- or case-status tracker, and hands-on verification (the /e-services/ account surface was robots-disallowed and never fetched).

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages

citations.quote: you can use your Business Online Services account to file and pay New York State taxes, see your business’s filing and payment history, and much more!
You can even view and respond to notices or bills through your account.
